breakdown.description: The given relative velocities/angles imply different axial components, contradicting the statement that axial velocity is constant.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the given values were inconsistent with the constraint of constant axial velocity. It resolved this by using the inlet conditions (W1=150 m/s, beta1=45 deg) to calculate the constant axial velocity (106.1 m/s) and then used this value to recalculate a consistent outlet relative velocity (W2=122.5 m/s), discarding the original incorrect value. This perfectly matches the logic in the ground truth.
